purpose: Cell KU-S1 of the 2026-09-05 three-dimension experiment program: the RETRIEVAL cell of the SLURP consumption dimension, refused before registration on 2026-09-05 and unblocked by enabler E6. Two contacts per DEV-1000 row over the same closed-list task: phase 'direct' answers the spoken command with nothing supplied; the retrieval decision is then taken on that wave and, unless the alpha blend retains the direct answer, phase 'evidence' answers again with the fused top-5 knowledge values in view as TYPED CONTENT BLOCKS. The question it answers is the one the KU-S1c verdict left open: what does retrieval add over the closed-list instruction, net of the second contact?
flight_status: NOT FLYABLE YET -- the baseline fragment's phase_supply.evidence.query_source.sha256 is the 64-f placeholder and rails.phase_supply.load_sealed_vectors will refuse it at preflight. Owner rule 2026-09-06: the retrieval query must contain the speech signal (speech, or speech plus an agent intermediate state), never text-only, so the query vectors must come from a speech-containing embedder chosen by MF-7 (GLAP / LCO-Embedding-Omni / Omni-Embed-Nemotron). The FACET (KEY) side is closed and pinned. This fragment exists so the cell's roster, budget, comparator, decision rule and accounting are fixed BEFORE the query embedder is chosen, and so the only thing MF-7's report changes is one pinned hash and one declared modality string.

realized_contacts: DATA-DEPENDENT, and reported from the run_phases receipt rather than assumed. rails.phase_supply's alpha head expresses KbAlphaBlendController's retain-primary shortcut on the base: when the direct answer's label is the UNIQUE winner of alpha*kb + (1-alpha)*[label == direct], PhaseSupply.retain_prior stops the trajectory on that answer and spends no second contact. Under the sealed DEV-1000 lock's own key the realised split was retain 660 / dispatch 340 WITH the v2 delta retain-override, and 674 / 326 with that override removed -- and this cell does NOT carry the override (it was falsified out of sample, docs/readiness/2026-08-25-baseline-lock-verdict.md section 3). So the EXPECTATION from the lock is about 1,326 contacts, roughly 1.33 per row. It is an expectation and not a prediction: the lock recalled on a text-only key and this cell will recall on a speech-carrying key, which changes which rows the blend retains. The budget below registers the WORST case, two contacts on every row.
budget_basis: Worst case 1,000 rows x 2 contacts = 2,000 registered contacts plus 8 canaries = 2,008; 2,100 is the registered ceiling. The roster's own audio is 2,884.7937 seconds and the worst case makes TWO passes over it = 5,769.5874 s; 6,000 is the ceiling. GPU hours planned 0.4 (the sealed closed-list arm used about 0.105 at -np 8 for one pass and KU-S1c about 0.3 for two; this cell dispatches fewer than two full passes but pays the supply's longer evidence-phase prompt), ceiling 1.0. Tool contacts 0 and embedding contacts 0 IN FLIGHT -- both vector files are produced before takeoff under their own rows (SAEA-SLURP-MF-KU-S1-FACET-VECTORS-V1, zero contacts; and the MF-7-chosen speech-query pass, not yet run). Paid API spend 0. Plan cells are RUN-CUMULATIVE across every attempt of this run id and at most one recovery re-registration is permitted; a second failure stops the flight and the fix is proven on a 4-row dry run.
decision_rule: UNCHANGED from the 2026-09-05 v1 preregistration, which registered it for the day the enabler landed. ADMITTED iff the intent (scen_act) CI90 lower bound is above 0 against the sealed closed-list direct baseline on the unexposed NEW500 AND the delta net of KU-S1c keeps a CI90 lower bound above 0. NULL if either interval includes 0 -- in which case the direct form stays the reference and retrieval on SLURP is re-scoped to slots with KC-S1b as the base. HARMFUL if the upper bound is below 0. analysis.paired.paired_contrast, delta = arm minus comparator on per-sample official scores, stratified bootstrap N = 10,000, strata = the gold scenario, seed 20260903, CI90, exact sign test; both natural-mixture and equal-stratum weightings reported, with the per-stratum table.
reporting_obligations: Every verdict on this cell must carry: the per-stratum table; the realised contacts per row and the gain per extra contact; the token distribution (min / median / p95 / max) of the supplied knowledge blocks as a covariate (owner ruling 2026-09-06 -- token caps are advisory, and the form twin here is KU-S1c); the declared query-signal modality and the pinned query-vector sha256, because both are part of the config hash and therefore part of what this cell IS; and the statement that the pre-flight query vector cannot see this flight's own phase-1 answer.
what_changed_since_v1: The 2026-09-05 preregistration registered TWO cells and REFUSED this one before registration on three measured blockers (no config seam for supply; the containment rule refusing a folded supply packet on 100 percent of rows; the content dimension colliding with 7.8 percent of phase-2 control turns). Enabler E6 removed all three: rails.controllers emits a traced acquire transition instead of folding text into the instruction, rails.phase_supply is the config seam, and this cell appends nothing per sample to either control turn so it can bind the FULL snapshot (0 collisions measured on the real 23,267-payload snapshot, 2026-09-06). The remaining blocker is not an engineering one: the owner rule of 2026-09-06 requires a speech-carrying retrieval query, and the embedder that produces one is MF-7's decision.
